name: Iron Pommel
summary: The Iron Pommel is the final missing fragment of Dartol's Rod, a rod created by the long-dead wizard Dartol and sought by the night elves of Astranaar to slow the furbolg attacks on their people. Entrusted to the druids of the Dor'Danil Barrow Den for safekeeping, it was lost when their sanctuary was slaughtered and overrun by oozes.

sections.title: A Slain Circle's Burden
sections.body: Dartol's Rod was divided and scattered across Ashenvale to protect its mystic power. The Iron Pommel was placed into the care of the night elf druids dwelling near the road winding south toward the Barrens. Tragedy struck the secluded enclave at the Dor'Danil Barrow Den when the circle was massacred, their tranquil shelter falling into ruined silence. The pommel vanished into the aftermath, swallowed by the grotesque, bubbling oozes that now shamble through the defiled glade.

sections.title: Recovered from the Mire
sections.body: With the druids dead, finding the pommel requires scouring the tainted hollow south of Splintertree Post. The relic remained locked away inside a sturdy chest. Adventurers cutting through the corrupt slimes discover the swallowed chest intact within an ooze's acidic mass, finally securing the last piece required for the rod's reconstruction.

faq.q: What is the Iron Pommel used for?
aliases: why do i need iron pommel
faq.answer: The Iron Pommel serves as the final component needed to reassemble Dartol's Rod. Bringing it to Shael'dryn at the moonwell allows her to mend the ancient artifact so it can be used to slow the furbolg attacks on the night elves of Ashenvale.
It was entrusted to the night elf druids living near the road heading toward the Barrens. Unfortunately, the circle was slaughtered before the rod could be reunited, leaving their haven in ruins.

aliases: where do i get iron pommel
faq.answer: The pommel is locked within a chest carried inside one of the corrupted slimes wandering the tainted hollow east of the main road, south of Splintertree Post and north of the Barrens border.

faq.q: Who do I bring the pommel to?
faq.answer: The pommel must be brought to Shael'dryn, a dryad tending the moonwell east of Iris Lake, who possesses the ritual knowledge to reconstruct Dartol's Rod.

angles.text: The pommel serves as a grim memorial to the fallen druids of Dor'Danil, whose sacred charge ended in slaughter at the edge of the forest.
Retrieving the pommel completes a critical stage in securing Dartol's Rod, an essential tool for defending Ashenvale against creeping corruption.
